messages.subject: Cloudvolume error
messages.body_plain:
I get such an error when running flywire_partner_summary() function
Error in cv$CloudVolume(cloudpath = cloudvolume.url, use_https = TRUE,  :
  formal argument "cloudpath" matched by multiple actual arguments

how can I fix it? otherwise dr_fafbseg() seems to give normal results.

messages.subject: Re: [nat-user] Cloudvolume error
messages.body_plain:
Dear Margo,

Thanks for your interest and sorry you’ve run into s bug. In theory this was fixed a couple of weeks ago

https://github.com/natverse/fafbseg/commit/ab024e1a0fd45f01e190e5001ff6fff78514c18b

Therefore could you update fafbseg (just follow the install instructions) restart R, try again and let us know how you get on. All the best,

Greg.

messages.subject: How to fetch neurotransmitter type prediction from hemibrain with neuprintr?
messages.subject_clean: How to fetch neurotransmitter type prediction from hemibrain with neuprintr?
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

Is there a way to fetch the prediction of neurotransmitter type for neurons of interest? Using the neuprintr, I didn't find related information in the metadata of neurons. It is neither displayed in the synapse info from neuprint_get_synapses.

Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: [nat-user] How to fetch neurotransmitter type prediction from hemibrain with neuprintr?
messages.subject_clean: [nat-user] How to fetch neurotransmitter type prediction from hemibrain with neuprintr?
messages.body_plain:
Dear Shuo, it is not available in hemibrain neuprint yet as there are a couple of other updates pending that were supposed to be bundled into a single new release. For comparison it is available in the manc dataset so you can see what it would look like (eg using malevnc package). If it takes much longer I guess we will make a static dump available. Best, Greg.

Sent from my iPhone
